text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired PD-5234 — GPU memory pressure detected on infer-west2a pool (3 nodes > 92%, NVML/CUDA errors). Auto-suppress: false.

pagerduty: PD-5234: paged eng-oncall (rotation) — please acknowledge.

alex: ack — taking lead. pulling node metrics and recent deploys.

alex: quick dump of nvidia-smi on node-n-204:
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes: GPU Memory |
|  GPU   PID   Type   Process name    Usage |
|   0   32455   C    python inference   31120MiB |
|   0   32476   C    python training    28600MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

alex: logs show repeated 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 6144 MiB' and fast retries. Looks like a single tenant job ramped memory with no limit.

maya: I'm pausing scheduling to infer-west2a and shifting new requests to infer-east1 on smaller models. Will scale down batch size for all prod routes hitting that pool.

sam: starting a drain on node-n-204, will evict best-effort jobs first. tagging evicted pods with reason=gpu-mem-pressure.

priya: customer-facing note: healthcare-corp (paid, high-priority) reported elevated error rate ~23% for embeddings — routing them to fallback model now. Logging incident impact to customer portal.

alex: killed runaway job pid 32455 (job id 91234) after confirming it's the spike source. Restart policy set to Never for that pod. Observed memory usage dropping on node-n-204.

incident-bot: Auto-escalation scheduled in 5m if PD-5234 not resolved / acknowledged by secondary.

maya: I've applied temporary resourceQuota override to cap per-pod GPU mem for the pool and updated autoscaler to refuse new large jobs until we verify.

sam: eviction finished on node-n-204, drain request succeeded. node memory now at 42%. no more NVML errors in last 30s.

alex: monitoring — tailing driver logs and nvml; will leave a watch for 15m. If stable, demote to advisory and close PD.

priya: posted initial status to #support and pinged healthcare-corp account. They acknowledged fallback route.

pagerduty: PD-5234 acknowledged by alex at 1776543243.

maya: handing off active watch to me for the night. Alex — can you create a short follow-up with the job owner + mitigation steps in the ticket?

alex: will open ticket (INC-7891) with job id 91234, actions taken, and recommended limits. Handoff noted.

maya: ack — I have the watch. If memory climbs >80% again or CUDA errors return, escalate to PD on-call and notify infra-sig.

incident-bot: Closing note: PD-5234 will auto-close when no NVML/CUDA errors seen for 10m and node memory <60%.

priya: will prepare a brief customer summary for morning and attach logs.

maya: thanks all — leaving a pinned checklist in the ticket for postmortem (limits, quota, autoscaler rule, owner follow-up).

sam: +1. good catch.

alex: thanks — signing off from active lead.

maya: end-handoff — monitoring continues.
